constraints.definition: CHECK ((((subject_kind = 'tenant'::text) AND (subject_id IS NULL) AND (policy_version_id IS NULL) AND (policy_id IS NULL) AND (policy_revision IS NULL) AND (metric_key IS NULL) AND (review_state IS NULL) AND (request_payload IS NULL)) OR ((subject_kind <> 'tenant'::text) AND (subject_id IS NOT NULL) AND (policy_version_id IS NOT NULL) AND (policy_id IS NOT NULL) AND (policy_revision IS NOT NULL) AND (policy_revision > 0) AND (metric_key IS NOT NULL) AND (sample_count >= 0) AND (sample_count <= '9007199254740991'::bigint) AND (sample_count IS NOT NULL) AND (covered_count >= 0) AND (covered_count <= '9007199254740991'::bigint) AND (covered_count IS NOT NULL) AND ((eligible_count IS NULL) OR ((eligible_count >= covered_count) AND (eligible_count <= '9007199254740991'::bigint))) AND (window_start IS NOT NULL) AND (window_end IS NOT NULL) AND isfinite(window_start) AND isfinite(window_end) AND (window_start < window_end) AND isfinite(measured_at) AND (measured_at >= window_end) AND ((source_through IS NULL) OR (isfinite(source_through) AND (source_through <= measured_at))) AND (review_state = ANY (ARRAY['inferred'::text, 'confirmed'::text, 'disputed'::text])) AND (review_state IS NOT NULL) AND (exclusions IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(exclusions) = 'array'::text) AND (group_ids IS NOT NULL) AND (request_payload IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof(request_payload) = 'object'::text) AND ((length(btrim(change_reason)) >= 1) AND (length(btrim(change_reason)) <= 1000)) AND (change_reason IS NOT NULL))))

workerFunctions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learn_slack_claim_jobs(p_worker uuid, p_batch integer DEFAULT 1)
 RETURNS SETOF platform_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare j public.platform_jobs%rowtype;begin
 if current_user<>'service_role' then raise exception 'slack_queue_forbidden' using errcode='42501';end if;
 if p_worker is null or p_batch is null or p_batch not between 1 and 5 then
  raise exception 'slack_queue_invalid' using errcode='22023';end if;
 -- One locked scan also recovers crashed workers. Exhausted attempts are retained
 -- as dead letters; no generic unbounded reclaim pass is needed.
 for j in select * from public.platform_jobs q where q.job_type='slack.history_sync'
  and ((q.status in ('queued','retrying') and coalesce(q.available_at,'-infinity')<=clock_timestamp()
    and coalesce(q.lease_expires_at,'-infinity')<=clock_timestamp())
   or (q.status='running' and coalesce(q.lease_expires_at,'-infinity')<=clock_timestamp()))
  order by q.priority,q.created_at,q.id for update skip locked limit p_batch
 loop
  if j.attempt_count is null or j.max_attempts is null or j.max_attempts<1 or j.attempt_count>=j.max_attempts then
   update public.platform_jobs set status='dead_letter',dead_lettered_at=clock_timestamp(),
    failed_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_expires_at=null,error_code='slack_history_attempts_exhausted'
    where id=j.id;
  else
   update public.platform_jobs set status='running',claimed_by='learn-slack:'||p_worker::text,
    claimed_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_expires_at=clock_timestamp()+interval '180 seconds',
    attempt_count=j.attempt_count+1,last_attempt_at=clock_timestamp(),
    started_at=coalesce(started_at,clock_timestamp()) where id=j.id returning * into j;
   return next j;
  end if;
 end loop;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.platform_jobs_claim(p_worker text, p_batch integer DEFAULT 5, p_lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 300, p_job_types text[] DEFAULT NULL::text[])
 RETURNS SETOF platform_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  update platform_jobs j set
    status           = 'running',
    claimed_at       = now(),
    claimed_by       = p_worker,
    lease_expires_at = now() + make_interval(secs => greatest(30, p_lease_seconds)),
    attempt_count    = j.attempt_count + 1,
    last_attempt_at  = now(),
    started_at       = coalesce(j.started_at, now())
  where j.id in (
    select c.id
    from platform_jobs c
    where c.status in ('queued', 'retrying')
      and c.job_type <> 'slack.history_sync'
      and (c.available_at is null or c.available_at <= now())
      and (c.lease_expires_at is null or c.lease_expires_at < now())
      and (p_job_types is null or c.job_type = any(p_job_types))
    order by c.priority asc, c.created_at asc
    for update skip locked
    limit greatest(1, least(50, p_batch))
  )
  returning j.*;
end;
$function$
